程序包com.sun.tools.doclets.formats.html的说明

This is the default doclet provided with JDK that produces Javadoc's default HTML-formatted API output. For more documentation on this doclet, please refer to the link below.
另请参阅:
http://www.java.sun.com/javadoc/standard-doclet.html

This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.
